soldier: Head brownish yellow, nasus brown with a reddish tinge, antennae yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow tinged with brown, the anterior half of the pronotum brown. Head hairs very sparse, only two long hairs behind the vertex; the anterior half and the tip of the nasus with more short hairs, the base of the nasus with a few short hairs in addition; the abdominal tergites with more microchaetae, the posterior margin of each segment occasionally interspersed with several long hairs. Small soldier very similar to the large soldier, only smaller in body size, the head slightly longer than wide or nearly equal in length and width, antennae with 12 segments.
